info.title: Fetcherr API
info.description:
Browse TMDB, request movies and series, and follow them until they are in Jellyfin. Every `/api` endpoint needs the API key (Settings → API key) in the `X-Api-Key` header or the `api_key` query parameter.

Paginated endpoints answer `{page, total_pages, total_results, items}` with 20 items per page.

Live events: WebSocket `GET /api/ws/events?requests=<id>,<id>&titles=<key>,<key>` (see the `Event` schema). Download progress: `GET /api/ws/downloads?ids=<id>,<id>`.

get.summary: One list, page by page (20 cards per page).
The discover pages (tabs), in their configured order.
A page's lists, in order, each with its first page of cards.

post.summary: Sends a search result to the download client. The returned id is the torrent info-hash.

delete.summary: Removes the download from qBittorrent. Files are kept unless `delete_files=true`.

parameters.name: delete_files
parameters.description: Also delete the downloaded files from disk.

post.summary: Reads the Jellyfin library again now instead of at the next interval.

200.description: Details, availability, requests and related lists
TMDB, IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes scores

get.summary: Releases of a movie for the manual picker. Post a `release_id` with `POST /api/requests`.
Every quality Fetcherr detects, best first.

post.summary:
Requests a movie, a season or episodes. The release search runs in the background; follow
it with `GET /api/requests/{id}` or the `/api/ws/events` WebSocket.

410.description: The chosen release expired, search again

200.description: The request with its torrents and imported files

delete.summary: Removes a request and its torrents from qBittorrent.

parameters.name: delete_files
parameters.description: Also delete the downloaded data and the files imported into the library.

post.summary: Searches again for a failed or not-found request.

get.summary:
Searches releases. Repeat `categories`, `qualities` or `indexer_ids` to pass several values.
Results only include allowed qualities, ranked in the media type's (or the requested)
quality order first, then by `sort`.

Replaces the discover layout. Pages and lists keep the order given; missing ids are made
from the names.
Library folders, import mode (hardlink or move), path mappings and naming templates.
Categories, download folder and qualities of one media type.
OMDb key, for IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes ratings.
TMDB key (v3 API key or v4 read access token), language and region.

502.description: TMDB unreachable or rejected the key

get.summary: Movies, series and people matching a text.

Opens the event stream. On connect (and after falling behind) a `request_updated` is sent for
every matching request (every unfinished one without a filter), then events as they happen:
`request_updated`, `request_progress`, `request_deleted` and `availability_changed`.
Authenticate with `?api_key=` since browsers cannot set WebSocket headers.

parameters.name: titles
parameters.description: Comma-separated title keys to follow, e.g. `movie:603,series:1399`.

101.description: WebSocket of JSON text frames, one event each

ApiKeyView.description: The API key, shown to whoever already holds it (or to the built-in UI).

Availability.description: Whether a title (or season/episode) can be watched, or is on its way.

Card.description: The one card model used by every list, search result and related title.

oneOf.description: Whole seasons. Empty `seasons` with `complete` means every season.

Coverage.description: What part of a title a release (or a file in it) covers.

DiscoverFilters.description: Filters for `discover` lists (ignored by the other sources).

genres.description: TMDB genre ids; a title needs at least one of them.

DiscoverListView.description: A list with its first page of cards (fetch more with `GET /api/discover/lists/{id}`).

error.description: Why the list is empty when TMDB failed for it.

DownloadClientSettingsInput.description: Omit `password` (or send it empty) to keep the stored one.

DownloadId.description: Torrent v1 info-hash in lowercase hex; doubles as the download identifier.

oneOf.description: State of the request covering this episode, if any.

ErrorBody.description: Error payload returned by every API endpoint: `{"error": {"code", "message"}}`.

oneOf.description: A request was created or changed state (also sent for each matching request on connect).
Download progress of a request, at most once per qBittorrent poll.

progress.description: Fraction from 0.0 to 1.0 over all of the request's torrents.

oneOf.description: A title, season or episode appeared in or disappeared from the media server.

Event.description: A message of `GET /api/ws/events`, sent as one JSON text frame. `type` tells which.

Images.description: Ready-to-use image URLs in several sizes.

ImportMode.description: How a finished download reaches the library.

path.description: Path in the library, as Fetcherr sees it.

IndexerSettingsInput.description: Omit `api_key` (or send it empty) to keep the stored one.

JellyfinSettingsInput.description: Omit `api_key` (or send it empty) to keep the stored one.

LayoutInput.description: A layout sent by a client. Missing ids are generated from the names.

movies_folder.description: Library root for movies, as Fetcherr sees it (e.g. `/media/movies`).

oneOf.description: Series with an episode in the next 7 days.
TMDB discover, shaped by the list's filters.

ListSource.description: Where a list's titles come from on TMDB.

MediaType.description: What a release is, deciding its search categories, qualities and download folder.

allowed_qualities.description: Most preferred first; search results are ranked in this order. Empty allows every quality.
Most preferred first; search results are ranked in this order. Empty allows every quality.

download_folder.description: Empty uses the download client's root folder.

NamingSettings.description:
Name templates. Placeholders: `{title}`, `{year}`, `{tmdb_id}`, `{season}`, `{episode}`,
`{quality}`; add `:02` for zero padding (`{season:02}`). A multi-episode file renders
`{episode:02}` as `01-E02`.

oneOf.description: Only this quality, instead of the media type's ranking.
A release from `GET /api/{movies|series}/{tmdb_id}/releases`, instead of picking one.

OmdbSettingsInput.description: Omit `api_key` (or send it empty) to keep the stored one.

PageTab.description: A discover page as a tab.

Page_Card.description: One page of a list. Every paginated endpoint answers with this shape.

items.description: The one card model used by every list, search result and related title.

Page_RequestSummary.description: One page of a list. Every paginated endpoint answers with this shape.

error.description: Why it failed, or what is still missing.

progress.description: Fraction from 0.0 to 1.0 over all of its torrents.

Page_SearchResult.description: One page of a list. Every paginated endpoint answers with this shape.

items.description: A search hit: a movie/series card or a person (`result_type` tells which).

PathMapping.description: Rewrites a qBittorrent path prefix into the same folder as Fetcherr sees it.

RatingsView.description: Scores of a title. IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes and Metacritic need OMDb and an IMDb id.

oneOf.description: The searched media type, or the one whose categories match the release.

published_at.description: RFC 3339 publish date as reported by the indexer.

ReleaseId.description: Opaque handle to a search result, valid while the release cache remembers it.

error.description: Why it failed, or what is still missing.

progress.description: Fraction from 0.0 to 1.0 over all of its torrents.

coverage.description: What Fetcherr takes from it for this request.

oneOf.description: Live qBittorrent state, absent once imported or when unknown.
Every aired episode of a season.

Scope.description: The part of a title a request wants.

SearchResult.description: A search hit: a movie/series card or a person (`result_type` tells which).

available_episodes.description: Aired episodes present in the media server.

oneOf.description: Overrides the media type detected during the search.

save_path.description: Overrides the media type's download folder.

quality_rank.description: Position in the quality preference, 0 = most preferred; absent when unranked.

TitleRelease.description: A release of a known title, with what it contains.

TmdbSettingsInput.description: Omit `api_key` (or send it empty) to keep the stored one.

TorrentState.description: What happened to one torrent of a request.
